index 2d4f67bba..80e826fe7 100644
--- a/sphinx/util/typing.py
+++ b/sphinx/util/typing.py
@@ -305,6 +305,9 @@ def stringify(annotation: Any) -> str:
         return annotation.__qualname__
     elif annotation is Ellipsis:
         return '...'
+    elif hasattr(annotation, '__module__') and hasattr(annotation, '__qualname__'):
+        # Handle struct.Struct and other non-typing classes
+        return '%s.%s' % (annotation.__module__, annotation.__qualname__)
 
     if sys.version_info >= (3, 7):  # py37+
         return _stringify_py37(annotation)
